AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#680 @ f267417a3ccd0864d3c8ba848323da16225d7aab — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/2

Agent 119 · AUD-SOL-R34D-119 · independent T4 round-7 delta; 2,779 changed lines, grandfathered under 3,000. The lower-piece merge `bef96175` leaves the R3 runtime files unchanged, then `f267417a` changes only the revoked predicate, paid-invoice terminal guard, strict decline fence/unpaid preservation and paired-update control. Lower R1/R2 deltas were read for boundary compatibility; no original #654 approval or other lens's verdict is inherited. [Round-7 scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5984124704).

### Prior findings first — CLOSED

- **B-680-1**, `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts:94-107,1320,1763-1765`: refunded, chargeback_lost and disputed-without-access now join canceled/expired/incomplete_expired; the locked invoice guard is unconditional, independent of prefetch timing, and the same predicate fences subscription grants/declines/deletion history. Financial settlement still carries the known charge and actual invoice amount without restoring access or seeding content. [Fixed code and regression map](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5984124704) [Independent execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).
- **B-680-2**, `:1915-1921`: no status-only past_due exception remains; every write after the failed-invoice read requests redelivery. The paid-write-into-past_due and already-past_due cases do not reopen dunning; the paired subscription update costs one redelivery, after which an unpaid latest invoice opens dunning once. [Fix](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5984124704) [Executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).
- **C-680-11**, `:1926-1928`, and **C-680-12's status-revoked pause_collection counterexamples** close in the same fix: unpaid stays unpaid, while revoked rows stay unentitled on active subscription updates, including pause_collection plus cancel-at-period-end. The separate durable D2c dispute-pause obligation below is not waived. [Regression table](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5984124704) [Independent execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).
- Earlier B-680-3/4/5/6 and B-654 logging/lookup cases remain closed on their previously reported counterexamples; own-card/end-lift, granted/own-card deletion consumption, real PostgreSQL dunning window and two reminder FK rows pass. [Independent replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).

### Evidence and limits

Independent candidate-source lane **37234258467: 19 suites / 321 tests PASS**, comprising prior Sol authority/legacy/PG probes, an additional 48-case terminal × event-alias × prefetch-timing matrix, candidate R3 regressions, all R4 files, both R5 files, and the lower identity/collector regression. Probe-only `6b0e7e58048fc33a9f49676bdbac1dd16100915e` plus wrapper `8684b0a444ba23a90ff9d1877cddd4ce065c7b36` changes no runtime/schema/dependencies; all three candidates have identical complete src/Prisma/lockfile trees, so this composed-top execution applies to R3's runtime. [Independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).

Builder failing-before was inspected: **24 failed / 20 passed** on `216489ff` plus tests, with no runtime changes; passing-after/replay **303 passed / 8 failed** is not described as green. The eight old assertions are accounted for individually: two old first-payment fixtures; one old exact attach-call shape; one unshimmed PG reminder fixture; one canceled-row regrant observation; two old no-redelivery expectations; and optional C-680-13. Current required assertions and the prior Sol boundaries pass without product patches. [Failing-before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37231939325) [Builder replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37231956053) [Independent passing proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).

The real-PG proof remains runner-only lock/FK evidence, not full-schema or live-Stripe acceptance; no local heavy execution occurred. [Independent PostgreSQL execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467).

### Follow-ups (C)

- **C-680-7 — retained:** `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts:796-801`, unindexed `stripe_client_secret startsWith` fallback; metadata-first does not eliminate Stripe's pending-SetupIntent path. Fix rule: additive indexed SetupIntent-id migration newer than `20270316000000`, equality lookup and representative plan proof. [Prior finding/disposition](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5983671709).
- **C-680-16 — outside this diff; owner decision pending:** `src/checkout/refund-dispute-handler.service.ts:301-302,1410`, full recurring refunds revoke access but do not pause future subscription billing. With no automatic regrant, a later charge can settle while access remains off. Recommended default: pause future plan billing on full recurring refund like R-DISPUTE-PAUSE; keep partial refunds and one-time purchases unchanged. [Refund/revocation integration recorded in the prior audit](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5983671709) [Round-7 terminal contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/680#issuecomment-5984124704).

### Composition / operator default

This slice does **not** attest global dispute-pause release readiness: the final D2c durable pause marker must fence subscription/paid-invoice grants, v1 resolution and v2 clear even after a won/closed dispute changes purchase.status. Keep V2 off until its complete audited integration; preserve R3's unconditional terminal guard alongside the durable pause reader, not instead of it. [Previously proved composed-fees dependency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37228991086) [D2c acceptance scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37230747608).

A naïve merge of D2c's DunningState lock after R3's purchase lock can oppose pause/restart's DunningState → purchase order; require one consistent composed order and a real two-worker probe before enablement. Preserve own-card/liftTrialEnd, both-party deletion/send fences, exact-charge settlement and all R4/R5 tests on the final fees restack. [R3 PostgreSQL proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37234258467) [D2c composition scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37230747608).

All **10 emitted checks pass at this exact head**; the nonrequired deploy-readiness gate is skipped. CodeQL, danger, Banned cast tokens and build-sbom remain main-composition gates because this base is stacked; approval is slice-scoped, not merge/deploy authorization. [R3 exact-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37232586036/job/111525241137).

Operator default: accept B-680-1/2 closure and the one-redelivery fence; ticket Cs, then merge-only restack onto the final fees top, read every conflict hunk and obtain fresh short dual exact-head deltas plus composed-main gates. Report: `ops/reports/AUD-SOL-R34D-119.md`.
